definitions.explanation: An interrogative expression used to ask about the number of small, round, or compact objects. Combines the question word 何 with the general-purpose counter 個.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何個|なんこ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何個|なんこ}⟦{買|か}えば→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many eggs should I buy?

examples.japanese: ⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何個|なんこ}⟦{用意|ようい}すれば→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check how many cardboard boxes we need to prepare.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what / how many) and ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (counter for small objects). This is one of the most frequently used counter question words in daily conversation, since ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ is the most versatile general counter for objects.

RELATED COUNTER QUESTIONS:
- {何本|なんぼん}: how many (long objects — bottles, pens, umbrellas)
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧: how many (flat objects — sheets, tickets, plates)
- ⟦{何杯|なんばい}→何杯：08779_nanbai⟧: how many (cups, glasses, bowls)
- {何台|なんだい}: how many (machines, vehicles)

USAGE:
The counter ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ applies broadly to small, compact, or round items: fruits, eggs, balls, boxes, bags, pieces. When the specific counter is unknown, ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ serves as a safe default for physical objects.
